clues.text: This city sits in a low valley in the heart of South Korea. High hills and a wide river frame it on each side.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside central South Korea

source.quote: Located in a central lowland valley between the Sobaek Mountains and the Geum River

clues.text: Its year splits in two: wet, hot summers, then cold, dry winters, shaped by monsoon rains.
clues.narrowing: narrows to the monsoon band of central Korea with wet summers and dry winters

source.quote: It experiences a monsoon-influenced, four-season climate with wet, hot summers and drier, cold winters.

clues.text: New state jobs came here from the far capital in the 1980s. In 1989 it won full big-city status.
clues.narrowing: shortlists Korean cities raised to metropolitan status in 1989

source.quote: From the 1980s, multiple national administrative functions were moved from Seoul to Daejeon, most of which are now located in the Government Complex, resulting in another population increase. It was elevated to the status of metropolitan city in 1989.

clues.text: In 1993 it hosted a world expo, the kind of huge fair kids still love to picture.
clues.narrowing: near-decisive: the Korean city that hosted the 1993 expo

source.quote: hosted the Expo '93, and the 2000 International Mathematical Olympiad

clues.text: It is home to KAIST, a science and tech school known across the land. Big research labs for Samsung and LG work here too.
clues.narrowing: converts: the KAIST and research-hub city
